sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 1** across iconic comic strip radio adaptations, classic Thirties low-pressure door-to-door sales comedy, postwar satire rehearsals, inspirational anthologies, and suburban domestic situations, Penny Singleton and Arthur Lake in *Blondie* for Camel and Super Suds (1941, 1944), Al Pearce as Elmer Blurt for Pepsodent (1934), Peg Lynch and Alan Bunce in *The Couple Next Door* (1960), *The Bob Sweeney and Hal March Show* (1948), and *Heartbeat Theatre* (1934–1963):
